title: An Attacker…Stomped!
front_description: With a savage thump, an unlucky Geonosian is hammered by a giant stamping machine. It all happens in the Geonosian droid factory, where Obi-Wan's would-be rescuers Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala are now fighting for their lives. On the far end of the conveyor belt, the young Jedi continues to work his way down toward Padmé, lightsaber flashing, winged creatures attacking from all directions.
back_description: Droid heroes come to the rescue in the Geonosian factory scene.
